verdict.rationale: Decagon's Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) let ops teams define agent behavior in natural language 'the same way you train human agents with SOPs,' with non-technical teams architecting and iterating on this logic, and Duet auto-generating AOPs from real interactions. This directly matches encoding step-by-step SOPs for known issue types. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of deterministic branching logic (conditional paths/decision trees) within AOPs and independent/hands-on validation of how strictly the agent adheres to defined steps.
